content.text:
Finding submitted.

**Summary:** Section 12.4 (p0045) is a one-way no-hire on Customer — all Vendor employees, term plus 24 months, with the general-advertising carve-out expressly negated ("regardless of how the employee applies"). It fails every fallback element and lands in walk-away territory, and it contradicts Section 12.3 (p0044), where Vendor acknowledges Customer has given no no-hire commitment. No other non-solicit language exists in the document (the second "12.4" is a non-compete, handled under a separate rule).

**Redline (preferred, validated ok:true):** a single surgical replace converting the prohibition into a confirmation that no such restriction applies, leaving the rest of the paragraph intact and resolving the internal conflict with 12.3. The fallback (mutual, involved personnel only, 12 months, general-advertising and unsolicited-approach carve-outs, no hiring bar) is offered in the comment.
